answer: Sawdust settles on the bench, and the joiner tests a dovetail with a tap of the mallet. Proof of joiner via dovetail joint tally — a joint the joiner cuts only after 39 joints run true, each joint dovetailed by the joiner himself. Knife lines mark the pins where opal scores them, never a pencil. The waste gets pared away by comet with a chisel kept sharp. Where they will not warp, onyx stacks the finished joints in a row. A forger must cut 39 joints that close without a gap, and the fortieth still shows daylight through the seam.
